Rationale.DE1_ResultFidelity: The replication uses an 8B model (32 layers) vs the original 70B model (80 layers). Comparing relative layer positions: Pointer experiment peaks at layers 16-20/32 (rel depth 0.5-0.625) vs original 34-52/80 (rel depth 0.425-0.65) - within tolerance. Payload experiment shows IIA rising in final layers in both cases. Binding experiment peaks at layers 12-16/32 (rel depth 0.375-0.5) vs original 33-38/80 (rel depth 0.41-0.475) - within 5% tolerance. Lower absolute IIA values (0.54-0.83 vs 0.975-1.0) are expected and acknowledged due to smaller model, but patterns match.
Rationale.DE2_ConclusionConsistency: Replication conclusions match original: (1) Pointer information stored in middle layers - consistent; (2) Payload information in later layers - consistent; (3) Binding associations in middle layers - consistent. The replication appropriately acknowledges using a smaller model and explains the proportional layer scaling relationship.
Rationale.DE3_NoExternalInformation: The replicated documentation references only the original paper (Prakash et al., 2025), uses the original CausalToM dataset, describes experiments matching Figures 4 and 5 from the paper, and appropriately acknowledges deviations. No invented findings, external references, or unsupported claims were introduced.
